title: GEO-linked ICE IGSA nine-facility chain crosswalk

denominator.capacity_scope: Sum of the nine distinct SEC facility-table capacities. It is not an ICE bed guarantee; Joe Corley's ICE-exclusive commitment is 1,050 of 1,517 physical beds.

aggregation_rules: Alexandria Staging and Central Louisiana share the LaSalle EDD chain.
D. Ray James and Folkston share the Charlton County chain.
Pine Prairie and South Louisiana share the Evangeline Parish Sheriff chain.
Shared-chain annual amounts must be counted once, not once per facility row.
Annual local fund flows, unit rates, monthly rates, task-order adjustments, and administrative fees are incompatible measures and are not summed.
No six-chain federal obligation total or GEO-receipt total is supported by the acquired records.

baseline_comparison.prior_scope: Five chain paths covering eight of the nine SEC ICE-IGSA facility rows.
baseline_comparison.new_scope: Joe Corley Processing Center adds the ninth facility row and sixth independent chain.
new_primary_records: Montgomery County public copy of ICE P00040
Montgomery County-GEO 2013 operating agreement and first amendment
Montgomery County FY2025 Annual Comprehensive Financial Report
new_financial_observations: FY2025 mixed ICE+USMS Fund 222 revenue and operations expenditure of $43,194,467 each
Effective 2025-11-01 transportation rate of $228,019.07 per month
Historical 2013 county administrative fee of $500,000 per year

facility_rows.sec_customer: USMS / ICE; ICE IGSA independently verified

KARNES.geo_role: GEO ownership/operation is disclosed in the SEC facility table; the exact downstream GEO legal entity is unresolved because the county-GEO instrument was not acquired.
KARNES.terms: Base obligates $0; performance requires funded annual task orders; subcontract flow-down and CLIN-supported invoices required.
KARNES.amount_scope: The zero is the base action only and is not an estimate of spending.

LASALLE.geo_role: ICE modification identifies Geo Group as Sub-K; local agreement passes operating duties and the ICE per diem to The GEO Group, Inc.
LASALLE.terms: Same ICE per diem and same ICE-originated price adjustment; ICE/LEDD inspections; local term linked to continuing IGSA; 2010 tiered administrative fee.
LASALLE.amount_scope: Same-year audited line items for one shared chain. The $232 mismatch prevents an exact same-dollar pass-through claim; fee is separate.

CHARLTON.geo_role: ICE P00022 identifies GEO as subcontractor; county agreements assign facility operation to GEO.
CHARLTON.terms: P00022 period 2022-02-16 through 2027-02-15; county quarterly audit; bilateral 30-day convenience termination; compensation and county fee publicly redacted.

CLEARFIELD.geo_role: ICE modification says The GEO Group, Inc. submitted the October 2024 request for equitable adjustment.
CLEARFIELD.terms: P00014-P00016 approve rate changes effective 2024-09-29; public values are redacted.
CLEARFIELD.amount_scope: County budget accounts only. Direction/sign of $4,687,231 is unresolved; it is not an established ICE-to-GEO payment and is not netted with the fee.

EVANGELINE.geo_role: ICE modifications identify GEO as subcontractor; local audit ties the Prisoner Maintenance Fund to the parish-GEO agreement.
EVANGELINE.terms: Reviewed modifications extend performance through 2025-06-28 and address wage/rate adjustments; amounts are redacted.
EVANGELINE.amount_scope: Fiduciary fund lines for one shared chain. The transaction lines do not independently name ICE as payer or GEO as payee.

MONTGOMERY.geo_role: P00040 says GEO submitted the county's REA/SCA adjustment; the 2013 county contract names GEO Corrections and Detentions, LLC as operator.
MONTGOMERY.terms: Written funded orders only; actual-detainee-day payment basis; 1,050 ICE-exclusive beds; public P00040 period ends 2026-01-14; 2013 local agreement passes the same ICE/USMS per diem to GEO net of the county fee.
MONTGOMERY.amount_scope: The FY2025 fund combines ICE and USMS; rates are not expenditures; retroactive payment is discrete; $500,000 is historical and not presumed current. None are summed.

document_acquisition_leads.scope: Missing base instruments, task orders, local operator agreements, amendments, control and fee terms for the original five paths.
Payment attribution, ledgers, invoices, checks/EFTs, FSRS and federal obligation reconciliation for the original five paths.
Current Joe Corley ICE task orders, invoices, and post-2013 county-GEO amendments.

verification.reason_left_unverified: The exact API payloads are preserved in finding evidence, but the original five-chain raw temp outputs were not durable in this run and were not personally re-executed.
